title: Generalization vs Residual Memorization
hypothesis: After late modular-addition generalization, performance that survives partial removal of dominant Fourier modes is predominantly alternative generalized computation rather than membership-specific residual memorization.

scope.claim_limit: A positive result means no material residual memorization was detected by the preregistered membership-gap assay. It does not prove that every historical trace was erased.

sweep.ranking: all non-DC conjugate Fourier pairs ranked by late embedding energy, descending

interpretation_limits: The old and heldout partitions are random subsets of the same modular-addition function, so a persistent old-only advantage under the same intervention is the operational signature of residual memorization.
Synchronized degradation of old and heldout performance supports shared generalized computation, but does not prove that every historical parameter trace vanished.
The early seen-vs-unseen gap is a positive control showing that the assay can detect membership-specific memorization in the same trained model family.
The oracle cumulative-replay model must itself satisfy the coupling assay; otherwise the diagnostic is considered invalid rather than evidence against the hypothesis.
Random-label controls must remain valid memorization controls and must not pass the full 001b gate.
No Cell growth, routing, mitosis, tissue, apoptosis, or new training mechanism is introduced.
